title: InternalGeneratorPrepare
description: Body of POST /internal/generators (test-control -> data-generator). Configures one generator for one flow. test-control owns port allocation, so it passes the port the generator must bind. The generator derives its role (echo / send / receive) from the flow's type + direction; there is no role field.

device_id.description: Device under test; stamped as a join column in the server's packets.parquet.

flow.description: The single port-less flow this generator serves.

server_port.description: Allocated port for this flow; the generator binds it.

node_log_dir.description: Filesystem path for this node's server/ log subtree for the test (where the logger sink writes segmented Parquet).
